speaker: Doctor
text: I see you've presented with right leg weakness, unsteady gait, multiple falls, forgetfulness, and paranoid behavior. Let me start by asking: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Angiitis of the Central Nervous System (PACNS).

I need to see the results of an MRI of your brain with contrast to look for infarctions or inflammation. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_BRAIN_with_contrast.

Also, please tell me if you have experienced any severe headaches, changes in your sense of smell, or vision problems recently.
